A complete browser shell

Use Ctrl+T and Ctrl+Tab to create and switch tabs. Drag a tab to reorder it. Ctrl+D bookmarks this page; Ctrl+H and Ctrl+B open the local managers.

Streaming downloads

The 100 MiB fixture is generated in small chunks by the loopback server. Open Ctrl+J to pause, resume or cancel it.

Reports use an explicit native save dialog.

Find, zoom and print

Find this text: café and CAFÉ. Hidden text is excluded from rendered search. Ctrl+F highlights shaped text; Enter moves to the next match.

Use Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 for the saved per-site zoom. Ctrl+P exports the owned display list as a basic A4 PDF, using a background file worker.

Native settings live at about:preferences. Omnibox suggestions come only from local history and bookmarks.

No external assets, trackers, telemetry, service workers or background updates.
